deployments_detail.use: nRF54 series with Axon NPU for ultra-low-power on-device machine learning in IoT
Acquisition of Neuton.AI automated TinyML platform for sub-5KB edge ML models

Nordic Edge AI Lab: a cloud tool that generates ultra-compact Neuton ML models (typically under 5KB) from sensor data for anomaly detection, activity/gesture recognition and biometric monitoring, deployable on nRF54 Series SoCs and cellular IoT modules for on-device inference without cloud dependency. [Neuton (Nordic-owned, ex Neuton.AI)]
deployments_detail.value: Neuton models up to 10x smaller, faster and more efficient than other CPU-run models

deployments_detail.use: Axon NPU: a dedicated AI hardware accelerator core integrated into the nRF54LM20B wireless SoC that speeds up TensorFlow Lite / Neuton models for on-device tasks such as sound classification, keyword spotting and image-based detection in battery-powered IoT devices. [Nordic Semiconductor (Axon NPU)]
deployments_detail.value: Up to 7x faster performance and up to 8x higher energy efficiency vs competing solutions

deployments_detail.use: Edge Impulse TinyML partnership: integrated Edge Impulse Studio with Nordic nRF52/nRF53 (and later nRF9160 cellular) developer kits and the Thingy:53, enabling customers to build and deploy embedded ML models (motion detection, sound/audio recognition) directly on Nordic SoCs. [Edge Impulse]

Acquisition of Neuton.AI's fully-automated TinyML IP, core technology and engineering team to build sub-5KB no-code edge ML models into Nordic SoCs, forming the basis of Nordic's Edge AI Lab offering. [Neuton.AI]

Acquisition of US-based Atlazo's AI/ML IP and team, giving Nordic ownership of ultra-low-power AI/ML processing and advanced sensor front-end technology to accelerate edge AI capabilities in its low-power IoT products. [Atlazo]

nRF Cloud MCP server: a production read-only MCP interface (hosted by Memfault, OAuth 2.0, tiered rate limits) that lets AI assistants query deployed device fleet data - issues, traces, device vitals, metrics and software-version stats - via natural language for root-cause analysis and release validation. [Memfault / MCP (Claude, Cursor, Copilot, OpenAI Codex, Windsurf clients)]

Nordic Developer Academy AI assistant: an in-platform AI helper trained on Nordic documentation and resources that gives learners instant answers when they get stuck during self-paced courses. [none disclosed]

Nordic DevZone AI Bot: an AI-powered technical-support chatbot on the DevZone developer portal that answers technical queries, guides users through the product range and links to relevant pages, drawing on DevZone, technical documentation and nordicsemi.com content to reduce support wait times. [none disclosed]

AI-assisted embedded development via Nordic MCP servers: exposes nRF Connect SDK/Zephyr development guides, command references and semantic doc search to LLM coding assistants (Claude Code, Cursor, GitHub Copilot) to write code, explain APIs and accelerate routine firmware tasks. [Anthropic (Claude Code), Cursor, GitHub Copilot / MCP]
